pageTitle: Blog - TopWebExpert | Latest News & Tips on Web Development & Digital Marketing
metaDescription: Explore our blog to get the latest news, tips, and insights on web development, digital marketing, SEO, and more from TopWebExpert.

sections.heading: Blog Posts
sections.notes: h1, centered, #00c1ae, on bg-gray-100 page, max-w-5xl container.

items.cardLayout: White rounded-2xl card, hover:scale-105, whole card clickable -> navigate(`/blog/${slug}`). Image on top (h-52 object-cover) from http://localhost:8080/api/blog_images/{image}. Body: h3 title, description paragraph (text-gray-500 text-sm), date row with calendar icon, 'Read More' pill button (#00c1ae, inverts on hover).

sections.notes: Grid: 1 col mobile, 2 cols sm, 3 cols lg, gap-6. Button text: 'Read More'.

Numbered round page buttons (1..totalPages) centered below grid. Active page: bg #00c1ae white text; inactive: white bg, #00c1ae text + border. Clicking sets page state and refetches. Page size (limit) = 9.

api.responseShape: { posts: [{ id, title, description, date, image, slug }], totalPages: number }
